question: Is fail-closed `update_partial` plus operator inspection/replanning an acceptable initial recovery contract for failed package-installer and Gateway-cron mutations, or must this PR include an immutable operation identity and doctor/reconcile or retry workflow before merge?
rationale: The code can report uncertainty, but only maintainers can set the supported operator-recovery guarantee for externally mutated resources that may not be compensable.

options.title: Require recoverable operation tracking
options.body: Add a durable operation identity and an operator-facing doctor/reconcile or retry path, with exact-head live failure-and-recovery proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the bounded experimental contract
options.body: Keep fail-closed `update_partial` with inspect-and-replan recovery, but explicitly document that guarantee and require exact-head live package and Gateway failure proof.

recommendation.title: Require recoverable operation tracking
recommendation.body: Add a durable operation identity and an operator-facing doctor/reconcile or retry path, with exact-head live failure-and-recovery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment directly frames the unresolved recovery and operator-safety decision.
